Significant practical speedup of 8.9-11.6× over grid search while maintaining near-optimal candidate selection (top-1 correct on 5/6 tasks, Kendall τ of 0.76-0.96)

Comprehensive evaluation: Six datasets across three domains, proper ablation studies showing each component's contribution, appropriate use of Kendall's τ for ranking quality
Practical implementation: Clean API interface, proper hyperparameter documentation, uses LoRA and Flash Attention for efficiency

weaknesses: Limited evaluation scope: Only tested on 7B LLMs; authors acknowledge scaling to 1B/70B introduces challenges and similarity metrics/scaling laws may not hold, severely limiting practical applicability

High-quality experimental execution: Detailed hyperparameter specifications, reproducible setup, and extensive appendices with additional analyses (small models, training-free variants, alternative projectors)

weaknesses: Limited technical novelty: Primarily combines existing techniques (CKA, Successive Halving, scaling laws); the main contribution is domain application to VLMs rather than methodological innovation

Comprehensive evaluation: 7 datasets across 3 domains, 4 baselines, thorough ablation studies, sensitivity analysis, and extended experiments (small models, Q-former, training-free variants)

Excellent reproducibility: detailed implementation, hyperparameter specs, code snippet, commitment to release artifacts
